title: Cattle mutilations: the file the FBI closed with no culprits
excerpt: Cattle found dead under supposedly unusual circumstances and reports that multiplied from the seventies onward. A federal investigation ended without pointing to anyone. What did the FBI really see in the file?
content:
Cattle found dead under supposedly unusual circumstances, reports that multiplied from the seventies onward, and a federal investigation that ended without pointing to anyone. The topic comes from a Milenio 3 (Cadena SER) special, and at foro3d.com we think this is a case where it is worth telling both the mystery the ranchers saw and the official explanation.

What the FBI concluded after Operation Animal Mutilation 🔍

In 1979, after thousands of cases, the FBI opened an investigation into events that occurred on tribal lands in New Mexico, the so-called Operation Animal Mutilation, led by agent Kenneth Rommel. Satanic cults, UFOs, pranksters, and natural predators were all considered, and no one was identified as responsible. On January 15, 1980, the agency closed the case stating that none of the cases involved mutilations other than those of common predators. The files were released in 2010.

The mystery that survives the closed file 🐄

Forty-five years after the closure, the legend still has a life of its own: every cow found feeds the same old questions all over again. The official explanation is written and available, but the account of those who were in the field does not always match it. Do you have any information about these cases or know of firsthand accounts? Tell us: your contribution can help other readers better understand the file.
